title: Book Three · Chapter 45: Four Nights
story:
Leo's sixth reply arrives a little over a week later.

Ronan opens it at the table. Mum is writing a customer's name on a paper bag. Dad is still at work.

The first line is about the new pen.

Your writing is better. The door in your drawing is still bad.

Ronan laughs. He drew one beside the birthday story. Leo has put a little roof over it.

Then come the plans.

My aunt is coming with me. We will stay at my grandmother's place near the old market. Four nights. Saturday to Wednesday, at the start of your holiday.

Ronan takes out the school sheet with the holiday dates. The days fit. He puts a finger beside the first Saturday.

Leo's next lines give the journey times.

We plan to arrive at the main bus station at two in the afternoon. We go back on Wednesday morning. My aunt will buy the tickets nearer the day. I will write again when she has them.

Mum looks up.

“A place to stay?”

“His grandmother's. His aunt has family things to do too.”

“Then he won't be free every minute.”

“Four nights,” Ronan says. He counts them on his fingers. “Saturday, Sunday, Monday, Tuesday.”

“Quite enough time for several meals.”

He smiles and reads the last part.

My aunt will pay for the bus. I have some of my own money for food and small things. Not enough for the whole market. Tell Kai my feet are ready.

Ronan puts the letter flat. He can already picture the three of them near a ball.

He takes a spare sheet and writes down places. The park comes first. Then the hall, the market, and the road by the river.

Soon the list is longer than the space beside Leo's visit.

Mum sees the sheet before she spreads her cloth.

“Does Leo have that list?”

“Not yet.”

“Which places does he want?”

Ronan looks at the names again. Leo has asked about the games and the food. His letter does not mention the other places.

“I can ask.”

He leaves space beside the list. At the top, he writes Leo's grandmother. Then he puts his pencil down for a moment.

Leo will sleep at her house. His aunt has things to do there too. Ronan thinks about the afternoons he spends with Mum and Dad, even when he has no special plan.

He folds the spare sheet once. He can take a few ideas to the visit. They do not all need a place on a timetable.

He wants to write back at once, but Mum needs the table to cut cloth. He takes his paper into the yard.

He tells Leo the school dates are right. He can meet the bus outside the station's front doors. Mum has offered a meal, but Leo and his aunt need to choose a free evening first.

Then he writes about money.

We can walk most places. We don't need to buy something every day.

Dad comes through the gate as Ronan reaches the last line. He reads the letter from Leo and looks at the four nights.

“A proper visit,” he says.

“Will you be home for one dinner?”

“At the usual time. Tell me the day.”

Ronan finishes his answer. Before the post office closes, he buys a stamp and sends the seventh letter.

That evening, he shows Anna's card to Mum again. He points to the crooked door.

“Leo put a roof on mine.”

“Then your house is almost finished.”

Ronan shakes his head. “I still need a floor.”

He puts both letters away and opens his school book. The holiday is closer now, but it has not started yet.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

journey＝旅程；ticket＝车票；nearer the day＝临近日子时；proper＝像样的、完整认真的。

## 理解问题

1. Leo计划住在哪里、住几个晚上？谁和他同行？
2. 公共汽车票这时有没有买好？车费和日常零花钱分别由谁负担？

## 读句子

**My aunt will pay for the bus.**

拆开看：My aunt / will pay / for the bus.

我的姨妈／会付钱／支付这次乘车的费用。
